predictions.text: I predict that the film The Social Reckoning will perform moderately well in U.S. box offices, grossing between $40 million and $60 million.

I predict that the Pivdennyi Bridge in Kyiv remains operational but is under increased surveillance and protection, with at least one additional strike attempt against it by Russian forces by the end of Friday, 16 October 2026.

I predict that coastal regions of Georgia, particularly those near the coast, will experience the most significant impact from Hurricane Isaias, with widespread power outages affecting at least one county by the end of Friday, 16 October 2026.
I predict that there will be another school attack in Poland, possibly in a different county, by a 15-year-old student.
I predict that the extent of Houthi-controlled territories will expand further into Yemen, particularly in the areas around Al-Turbah and the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
I predict that Eritrean forces will capture another town near Mekelle, such as Sheraro, by the end of Friday, 16 October 2026.
I predict that the Gaza war will continue with more Israeli airstrikes, resulting in at least one more Palestinian being killed and several more being injured by the end of Friday, 16 October 2026.
I predict that the Rapid Support Forces will conduct another drone strike in South Kordofan, resulting in at least one fatality.
I predict that the occupied West Bank will see another attack by Israeli settlers, resulting in at least 16 people wounded.
I predict that the semiconductor industry in Taiwan will see no new regulations or policies announced by the finance ministry in response to the record trade surplus.
